note: Defaults, ceilings and rules for Trader and Investor mode. Contains NO personal amounts (those live only in the user's profile in the database). Tightening a limit is always allowed; loosening it beyond its default needs an admin approval note and is audited; a ceiling can only be changed by editing this file (a versioned, reviewed change). Sources: owner design reviews of 2026-10-23.

decision_record.capital_partition: Two strictly separate pots: investment (money not needed for 5+ years) and trading (money that can be lost without touching goals). The emergency fund is a constraint, not a pot. A position never changes pot except by an explicit audited transfer, which is not offered yet. No default split is assumed.
decision_record.trader_limits: Conflict between the two owner reviews (0.5% vs 0.25% per trade; 4% vs 3% open risk) resolved to the stricter value as the default; the looser value is a ceiling needing an admin approval note. 1% per trade is never enabled.
decision_record.investor_mixes: Starting defaults, not recommendations; every mix is gated by the owner's tolerance check, emergency fund, liquidity needs and goal date.
decision_record.f_and_o: Defined-risk structures only, research/paper only, until an engine passes the promotion gate and the data and risk calculations are validated. No naked short options. No order placement from the UI.
decision_record.accounts: One person uses both modes, separated by the pots. Schema keyed by user_id so more accounts can be added later.

pots.investable_definition: investment_capital + trading_capital (the emergency fund is excluded)
pots.override: A trading pot above the share needs an admin override note; it is audited.

risk_per_trade_pct.unit: % of trading capital, at the stop, including estimated costs

open_risk_pct.unit: % of trading capital, sum of risk at stop of all open ideas

daily_loss_pct.unit: % of trading capital; reaching it stops new ideas for the day

weekly_loss_pct.unit: % of trading capital; reaching it halves sizing next week

max_pair_correlation.unit: pairwise correlation of daily returns, 60 sessions

liquidity_cap_pct.unit: % of average daily traded value (20 sessions median), never a single day

rebalance_band.rule: act if |drift| >= absolute_points OR |drift| / target >= relative_fraction; new SIP money goes to under-weights before any sale

investor.risk_profile_rule: the lower of capacity and tolerance; the goal calculator never raises equity to rescue an off-track goal (it shows trade-offs instead)

guardrails: Trader mode never shows a conviction or direction claim without an evidence label and the resolved sample size.
Investor mode never shows a single-point return forecast; always a range, always labelled a scenario.
Both modes distinguish RESEARCH, PAPER and APPROVED. No engine is approved today; the ML directional ranker stays rejected.
Every recommendation is reproducible from its data snapshot, model version, risk profile and capital partition.
